open! IStd

module UnixDiff = struct
  type t = Unchanged | New | Old [@@deriving compare, equal]

  let directive_of_char c =
    match c with
    | 'U' ->
        Unchanged
    | 'N' ->
        New
    | 'O' ->
        Old
    | _ ->
        Logging.die Logging.UserError "Unexpected char in input sequence. Failed parsing"
